bullets.content: [general] Use all 4 solves. S1 = assigned variant, S2 = push the factor further, S3 = opposite direction or anchor, S4 = best combination. Place refinements from first-solve hotspots; compare() consecutive pairs; submit by score formula (error x DOFs).

[general] Right after solve 1 call view(solve=1, kind=error, view=iso) and read 'element size near each group' (skipped repeatedly; f38 was 0.00405, not 0.0037). List each top-5 hotspot with group and local h. Local h >1.3x requested: refinement failed.
[general] Change exactly one factor per solve (edge size, radius and boxes together gave unattributable changes of 17.2% and 0.158->0.154). Compare to the previous solve, then combine winners.
[general] Never call compare(x,x) (repeated mistake) or order 2 vs order 1. Write solve numbers before calling; compare a candidate against the x0.75 reference, same order only.
[general] A one-box tweak gives a noise-level change. Use one solve for a structurally different recipe (e.g. different h or order), while changing only one factor per comparison.

[general] Spend solve 2 on a fine reference: same recipe, all sizes x0.75. compare(candidate, ref)x1.27 estimates true error; submit min e*DOFs. a14 did this and ranked 1st. Meshing is deterministic: reuse a known control's nodes/energy instead of re-solving it.
[general] When the plan names an experiment, run it or say why you switched. A promised tier1 zmax -0.0062 test was silently replaced by tier2 0.0033. The teacher checks promises.

[general] Use the spare solve for a distinct single-factor experiment or DOF-cutting variant, not a duplicate control. Do not re-solve a deterministic known recipe (a14 frame: 5277 nodes, 2.13341e-4 J; a4 frame: 5705 nodes, 2.13564e-4 J).
[general] Price each box with a free mesh() call. If it adds >3% nodes without a hotspot of >=3% share, skip it. Spend solves on a DOF-cutting variant plus an x0.75 reference.

[general] Pick submission by formula. Above target a refinement pays only if % error drop exceeds % DOF rise (lobe box: -3.4% error for +5.1% DOFs failed). Below target compare e^2*DOFs. Use compare(candidate, ref)x1.27. Pressure resultant mismatch is noise.
[general] Submit the lowest estimated e*DOFs candidate. If compare(candidate,ref)*DOFs differ <3%, submit the cheaper (a4 control 17115 DOFs, base 0.763, beat 17622 DOFs, 0.737).

[general] Name the binding term (field vs points) BEFORE adding DOFs. Lobe box cut field 8.15->7.94% but points stayed 8.06->8.19%: +507 DOFs bought nothing. If field is within 0.3 points of point RMS, stop buying field accuracy.
[general] Before adding a box, check the hotspot list: (1) a hotspot with >=3% share lies in the box; (2) its local h is >=1.6x the box size. The f9 box failed both (0.003 vs 0.004 is only 1.33x).
[general] In 3D order 2, error falls ~N^-2/3, so uniform refinement raises score only ~N^(1/3). Gains come from moving DOFs to hotspot regions, not smaller global h.
[general] Never spend solves on order 1 for thin-walled parts: order-1 at 10-17k DOFs gave energy 0.0208/0.0217 J vs 0.0329 J at order 2 (locking). Stay order 2.
[general] Setup verified correct and reused verbatim: fixed f2, 4e6 on f23, 2.1e6 on f16, E 2.1e11, nu 0.3, 3d. Keep it.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Solve plan: (1) a3's exact recipe as control (15465 DOFs); (2) control plus 4 rim points only; (3) if it helps, point size 0.002 or boxes; (4) reserve. compare(1,2) and check whether the change sits at the f16/f19 rims. Start order 2, not order 1.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Boss-root rim hotspots beside f16/f19 at (±0.0194, ±0.0075, ~0.030) hold 11.9% of error at h 0.005-0.0056 and top every run. The 4 points at 0.0025 r0.005 should give f16/f19 h<=0.0042, -3 to -5% error for <+1k DOFs (estimate).

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] After meshing read 'element size near each group'. If f16 touching h is still >0.0045, replace each point with a ±3 mm box at 0.0025 r0.005 (points failed on abc_00000065_bc0). Alternative: f19/f16 at 0.003 r0.006.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] a8 (a3 recipe plus flank boxes [0.009,-0.016,0.019,0.023,0.016,0.033] and mirror at 0.0035) gave best base 0.247 (18.1%, 18.9k DOFs), yet its f19 rim stayed at h 0.0047. Rim points are the cheaper alternative.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Cost is the limiter: coarse h 0.012 + body box 0.0058 gave 20.1% at 17k DOFs, score 0.257, beating the h 0.0045 family (base <=0.221). Keep the coarse-base structure and move DOFs to hotspots.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Best h 0.0045 recipe (a4: 16.1%, 26841 DOFs): order 2, f2 0.0025 r0.005, edges 39 and 8 at 0.002 r0.005. Edge size 0.003 gave 17.0-17.5% (24.2k DOFs). Base for the fine family.
[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Edge 40 (0.003 r0.005) is the clamp-ring edge at z~0.0575; keep it on a coarse base (ring cells still hold ~12%). At h 0.0045 it added DOFs without gain (17.7% vs 17.5%).

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Clamp ring (z≈0.056, f12/f22/f20) holds 13-17% of error energy at h 0.0037 in every run. f2 below 0.0025 is not a lever: 0.0018 cost +2.8k DOFs, change sat in saddle band. Keep f2 0.0025-0.003 r0.005; test 0.003 to save DOFs. Box 0.003 (a13) did not beat f2.
[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Clamp ring (f12/f22, z~0.056) still shows 140-360% local error: untested ring box [-0.02,-0.02,0.05,0.02,0.02,0.0575] at 0.003 r0.005.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Boss roots (|x| 0.016-0.023, |y|<0.011, z 0.022-0.037, near f16/f19) carry ~30% of error energy. Boxes at 0.0035 r0.004 gave only 17.5→17% for ~400 DOFs. Use size ≤0.6x h (≤0.0027) with r≥0.005.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] f20 saddle hotspots (±0.013, ±0.009, 0.024) lie ~0.0055 from edge 39. Saddle box [-0.016,-0.014,0.022,0.016,0.014,0.03]: 0.0028 gave 16.1->15.7% for +2k DOFs; 0.0035 under body box 0.0058 gave 20.7->20.1% for +1.5k (below break-even). Use 0.003 if reused; not next factor.
[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Uniform h shrink converged slowly (18.7% change at 24k DOFs). Coarsening to h 0.0058 with stronger local sizes was worse (17% change). Use targeted refinement.
[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Boss shafts/end faces (f15, f17, f7, f1, outer f16/f3 barrels) show near-zero error. Separate experiment: box at size 0.007-0.008 (|x|>0.024) to free ~1-2k DOFs.
[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Untested: global h 0.0052 with edges 39/8 at 0.0018 r0.006 and f2 0.0025 (~20k DOFs, ~17% error) to raise score via fewer DOFs. Or h 0.0038 with f2 0.003; split factors.
[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Order 2 at h=0.0045 gave min quality 0.244, no folded cells.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Order-1 variant (h=0.0055, box 0.0026, f2 0.0014, edges 39/8 0.0012) is superseded: order 1 locks and loses. Order 1 needs ~2x smaller h; 2.5 mm wall needs size <=0.0008, unaffordable.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Order-1 diagnostic: order-2 energy converges ~0.0337-0.0340 J. a14 order 1 at 21.7k DOFs gave 0.0220 J, compare 0.65 (thin-wall locking). If order-1 energy <~0.031 J or compare vs order 2 >0.3, it locked: report, do not submit.
[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Setup correct and unchanged: fixed f2, 4e6 on f23, 2.1e6 on f16, E 2.1e11, nu 0.3, 3d. Pressure resultants vary between meshes (curved faces, net ≈0): not an error.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Field error binds (20% vs check points 6.1-6.7%). Above target (e<15.96%) score = g/(2c), so DOFs must buy proportional accuracy. Judge by field error and compare(), not check points.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] a14 (base 0.787): tier1 0.0018 r0.003, tier2 0.003, band 0.003, f7 0.0035 r0.006, upper 0.0043. 15831 DOFs, field 8.54%, points 6.31%: points have margin, field is the lever. Base for one-factor changes.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] +y lobe boxes (0.0028 +930 DOFs -3.4%; 0.0034 [0.015,0.014,-0.0081,0.025,0.024,-0.002] +169 nodes, e*DOFs 1443 vs 1395) are break-even or worse. Drop; a14's band (y to 0.024 at 0.003) already covers the lobe.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] After meshing the +y box, read f38/f43/f8 touching h: should fall from ~0.0043 to <=0.0032. If nodes exceed 6700, shrink the box to x 0.013-0.024, keep zmax -0.001. Check quality >=0.1 (expect 0.11).

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Clamp layer z~-0.007 (f5/f7 over f12) holds 33-39% of error at h 0.0022-0.0028, 3-5% VM error: saturated. Do not add or shrink boxes; no tier1 below 0.0016. Test tier1 0.0018 r0.006 to save ~1k DOFs.
[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Avoid the -y f9 box [0.016,-0.023,-0.005,0.027,-0.013,0.0081] at 0.003: +310 DOFs, energy +0.03%, compare 0.0465 (noise); no hotspot there.
[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Never drop tier2 [0.012,-0.015,-0.0058,0.031,0.015,-0.003]: without it the mesh jumped to ~6800 nodes with quality 0.0962 (invalid) for a0 and a11. Keep tier2 at 0.003.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Point RMS is noisy ~1 point between near-identical meshes. Energy is a weak proxy for the low-stress +y lobe (+0.035% energy yet -3.4% compare): judge lobe refinements by compare vs x0.75 reference.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] a4 single graded bottom box 0.0016 r0.007 replaced the three-tier stack: 8.15% field at 17.1k DOFs (e*DOFs 1394 vs 1486). Lean base. a12 upper box 0.0043 + band 0.003 gave best base 0.775 at 15.8k DOFs: removing upper-wall DOFs pays.
